snippet.title: Outer Wilds — The Vision story mod release!
snippet.description:
Hey guys! I'm happy to announce that my mod for Outer Wilds — The Vision is OUT NOW!

LOAD THE MOD AND CHECK YOUR SHIP LOGS TO START!
Download mod here: https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/thevision/
Mod requiere both main game and DLC installed!

#outerwilds , #echoesoftheeye , #mobiusdigital 

Join our Outer Wilds Modding Discord server: https://discord.gg/9vE5aHxcF9
My discord: hearth1an#7222

All rights belongs to Mobius Digital.
Music used: Andrew Prahlow - We Have Liftoff
